jobs.title: Pre-Sales Engineer (Mid)
jobs.description:
Present and demo Delvitech's AI optical inspection systems to customers worldwide, turning their technical needs into the right solution. Job Summary Join Delvitech's TSE team, a multidisciplinary technical team that bridges customers, Sales, Product Management and Engineering, turning complex application requirements into effective technical solutions. As a Pre-Sales Engineer, you will lead the technical pre-sales process with customers around the world, from understanding their requirements to delivering demonstrations, evaluations, benchmarks and proofs of concept for Delvitech's advanced inspection technologies, and translating field feedback into actionable input for product development. Key Responsibilities
• Prepare and deliver tailored product demonstrations, technical presentations, workshops and customer visits.
• Analyze customer technical requirements and translate them into solutions based on the company's products and technologies.
• Configure and adapt standard product capabilities to address specific customer applications.
• Plan and execute technical evaluations, benchmarks and proofs of concept using representative customer products, samples and data.
• Prepare technical documentation, reports and supporting materials for commercial proposals.
• Provide technical training to customers and sales teams.
• Collect field feedback and translate it into functional requirements to be shared with Product Management and Engineering. Requirements
• University degree in Engineering or a related technical or scientific field. Candidates with a technical diploma and relevant experience may also be considered.
• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in a pre-sales, application engineering or customer-facing technical role.
• Outstanding communication and presentation skills.
• Strong interest in machine vision and electronics manufacturing (SMT).
• Fluent English.
• Willingness to travel internationally approximately 30 to 40% of the time (e.g. India, Morocco, North and South America). Nice to Have
• German or Spanish.
• Thesis, internship or experience in machine vision, AOI, SMT or automation.
• Basic knowledge of image processing, AI or data analysis.
• Experience supporting proofs of concept and benchmarks.
• Knowledge of Industry 4.0, MES or industrial communication protocols.
• Experience with CRM and project management tools. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Presente e demo Sistemi di ispezione ottica AI di Delvitech ai clienti in tutto il mondo, trasformando le loro esigenze tecniche nella soluzione giusta. Unisciti al team TSE di Delvitech, un team tecnico multidisciplinare che collega clienti, vendite, Product Management e Ingegneria, trasformando i requisiti applicativi complessi in soluzioni tecniche efficaci. Come Ingegnere Pre-Sales, guiderai il processo di pre-vendita tecnico con i clienti di tutto il mondo, dalla comprensione dei loro requisiti per fornire dimostrazioni, valutazioni, benchmark e prove di concetto per le tecnologie di ispezione avanzate di Delvitech, e traducendo il feedback sul campo in input attuabile per lo sviluppo del prodotto. Principali responsabilità
• Preparare e fornire dimostrazioni su misura del prodotto, presentazioni tecniche, workshop e visite ai clienti.
• Analizzare i requisiti tecnici del cliente e tradurli in soluzioni basate sui prodotti e sulle tecnologie dell'azienda.
• Configurare e adattare le funzionalità standard del prodotto per affrontare specifiche applicazioni del cliente.
• Pianificare ed eseguire valutazioni tecniche, benchmark e prove di concetto utilizzando prodotti, campioni e dati rappresentativi del cliente.
• Preparare documentazione tecnica, relazioni e materiali di supporto per le proposte commerciali.
• Fornire formazione tecnica a clienti e team di vendita.
• Raccogliere feedback sul campo e tradurlo in requisiti funzionali da condividere con Product Management e Engineering. Requisiti
• Laurea in Ingegneria o un campo tecnico o scientifico correlato. I candidati con un diploma tecnico e un'esperienza rilevante possono anche essere considerati.
• Almeno da 1 a 2 anni di esperienza rilevante in un ruolo tecnico pre-vendita, ingegneria delle applicazioni o rispetto al cliente.
• Competenze di comunicazione e presentazione eccezionali.
• Forte interesse per la visione della macchina e la produzione di elettronica (SMT).
• Inglese fluente.
• Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale circa 30 - 40% del tempo (ad esempio India, Marocco, Nord e Sud America). Bello da avere
• Tedesco o spagnolo.
• Tesi, stage o esperienza nella visione della macchina, AOI, SMT o automazione.
• Conoscenza di base dell'elaborazione delle immagini, dell'intelligenza artificiale o dell'analisi dei dati.
• Esperienza che supporta le prove di concetto e benchmark.
• Conoscenza dei protocolli di comunicazione industriale 4.0, MES o industriale.
• Esperienza con CRM e strumenti di gestione del progetto. Una posizione permanente in una società tecnologica in rapida crescita che sviluppa i propri sistemi di ispezione ottica basati su AI, con forti opportunità di crescita professionale man mano che l'azienda si espande.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Präsentieren und Demonstrieren Sie die optischen KI-Inspektionssysteme von Delvitech für Kunden weltweit und verwandeln Sie ihre technischen Anforderungen in die richtige Lösung. Treten Sie dem TSE-Team von Delvitech bei, einem multidisziplinären technischen Team, das Kunden, Vertrieb, Produktmanagement und Engineering verbindet und komplexe Anwendungsanforderungen in effektive technische Lösungen verwandelt. Als Pre-Sales-Ingenieur leiten Sie den technischen Pre-Sales-Prozess mit Kunden auf der ganzen Welt, vom Verständnis ihrer Anforderungen über die Bereitstellung von Demonstrationen, Bewertungen, Benchmarks und Konzeptnachweisen für die fortschrittlichen Inspektionstechnologien von Delvitech bis hin zur Übersetzung von Feedback vor Ort in umsetzbare Inputs für die Produktentwicklung. Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
• Bereiten und liefern Sie maßgeschneiderte Produktvorführungen, technische Präsentationen, Workshops und Kundenbesuche.
• Analysieren Sie die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden und übersetzen Sie sie in Lösungen, die auf den Produkten und Technologien des Unternehmens basieren.
• Konfigurieren und Anpassen von Standard-Produktfunktionen für spezifische Kundenanwendungen.
• Planen und führen Sie technische Auswertungen, Benchmarks und Proofs of Concept mit repräsentativen Kundenprodukten, Mustern und Daten durch.
• Bereiten Sie technische Dokumentation, Berichte und unterstützende Materialien für kommerzielle Vorschläge vor.
• Bereitstellung technischer Schulungen für Kunden und Verkaufsteams.
• Sammeln Sie Feedback vor Ort und übersetzen Sie es in funktionale Anforderungen, die mit Produktmanagement und Engineering geteilt werden. Anforderungen
• Universitätsabschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten technischen oder wissenschaftlichen Bereich. Kandidaten mit einem technischen Diplom und einschlägiger Erfahrung können ebenfalls in Betracht gezogen werden.
• Mindestens 1 bis 2 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in einer Pre-Sales-, Application Engineering- oder kundenorientierten technischen Rolle.
• Hervorragende Kommunikation und Präsentation Fähigkeiten.
• Starkes Interesse an Machine Vision und Elektronikfertigung (SMT).
• fließend Englisch.
• Bereitschaft, etwa 30 bis 40% der Zeit international zu reisen (z.B. Indien, Marokko, Nord- und Südamerika). Nizza zu haben
• Deutsch oder Spanisch.
• Abschlussarbeit, Praktikum oder Erfahrung in Machine Vision, AOI, SMT oder Automatisierung.
• Grundkenntnisse in Bildverarbeitung, KI oder Datenanalyse.
• Erfahrung mit unterstützenden Konzeptnachweisen und Benchmarks.
• Kenntnisse über Industrie 4.0, MES oder industrielle Kommunikationsprotokolle.
• Erfahrung mit CRM und Projektmanagement-Tools. Eine feste Position in einem schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen, das seine eigenen KI-basierten optischen Inspektionssysteme entwickelt, mit starken Möglichkeiten für professionelles Wachstum, wenn das Unternehmen expandiert.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentez et démonez les systèmes d'inspection optique AI de Delvitech aux clients du monde entier, transformant leurs besoins techniques en la bonne solution. Résumé de l'emploi Rejoignez l'équipe TSE de Delvitech, une équipe technique multidisciplinaire qui relie les clients, les ventes, la gestion des produits et l'ingénierie, transformant les exigences d'application complexes en solutions techniques efficaces. En tant qu'ingénieur pré-vente, vous dirigerez le processus technique de pré-vente avec les clients du monde entier, de la compréhension de leurs exigences à la livraison de démonstrations, évaluations, repères et preuves de concept pour les technologies d'inspection avancées de Delvitech, et de la traduction des retours sur le terrain en intrants concrets pour le développement de produits. Principales responsabilités
• Préparer et livrer des démonstrations de produits sur mesure, des présentations techniques, des ateliers et des visites de clients.
• Analyser les exigences techniques du client et les traduire en solutions basées sur les produits et les technologies de l'entreprise.
• Configurer et adapter les capacités standard du produit pour répondre à des applications client spécifiques.
• Planifier et exécuter des évaluations techniques, des repères et des preuves de concept à l'aide de produits, d'échantillons et de données représentatifs des clients.
• Préparer la documentation technique, les rapports et les documents d'appui pour les propositions commerciales.
• Fournir une formation technique aux clients et aux équipes de vente.
• Recueillir les commentaires sur le terrain et les traduire en exigences fonctionnelles à partager avec la gestion des produits et l'ingénierie. Exigences
• Diplôme universitaire en génie ou dans un domaine technique ou scientifique connexe. Les candidats possédant un diplôme technique et une expérience pertinente peuvent également être considérés.
• Au moins 1 à 2 ans d'expérience pertinente dans un pré-vente, l'ingénierie d'application ou un rôle technique orienté vers le client.
• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et en présentation.
• Un vif intérêt pour la vision des machines et la fabrication électronique (SMT).
• Anglais.
• Volonté de voyager à l'étranger environ 30 à 40 % du temps (p. ex. Inde, Maroc, Amérique du Nord et du Sud). Sympa d'avoir
• Allemand ou espagnol.
• Thèse, stage ou expérience en vision de machine, AOI, SMT ou automatisation.
• Connaissance de base du traitement des images, de l'intelligence artificielle ou de l'analyse des données.
• Expérience à l'appui de preuves de concept et de repères.
• Connaissance de l'industrie 4.0, du MES ou des protocoles de communication industrielle.
• Expérience avec CRM et outils de gestion de projet. Ce que nous offrons Une position permanente dans une société technologique en croissance rapide qui développe ses propres systèmes d'inspection optique basés sur l'IA, avec de fortes opportunités de croissance professionnelle à mesure que l'entreprise s'étend.

jobs.title: System Architect (CH)
jobs.description:
Shape the architecture of Delvitech's AI optical inspection systems, connecting hardware, software and AI into one reliable platform. Department: R&D Location: Mendrisio, Switzerland, 100% on-site Reports to: Head of R&D The Opportunity Delvitech develops advanced AOI (Automatic Optical Inspection) systems for electronics manufacturing. We are looking for a System Architect to strengthen the architecture and analysis of our next-generation software platform, working alongside our senior software architects. This is an individual-contributor role (no people management). Main Responsibilities
• Analyze requirements and translate them into a clear system architecture: modules, service boundaries, interfaces and data models.
• Contribute to the design of Delvitech's future software platform, from concept to production.
• Make pragmatic technology choices and stay close to the implementation (prototypes, proofs of concept, code reviews).
• Lead design and architecture reviews; raise engineering quality (testing strategy, CI/CD, performance, reliability, security).
• Work closely with hardware, machine-vision and software teams on hardware-software integration.
• Document architecture decisions and technical specifications. Requirements (Must Have)
• Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical field.
• 6+ years of software engineering experience, with solid hands-on experience in system architecture and design.
• Strong skills in at least one of: C++, Java/Spring, Python.
• Experience with distributed systems / microservices, REST/OpenAPI and Linux.
• Track record of bringing complex software systems into production.
• Professional fluency in English. Nice to Have
• Experience with industrial, embedded or hardware-software systems.
• Knowledge of machine vision, AOI or SMT/electronics manufacturing.
• Rust, TypeScript/React.
• Docker/Kubernetes, observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus).
• Experience integrating AI components into production software.
• Italian or German. Soft Skills Structured and analytical thinking, pragmatism, clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, mentoring attitude, ownership, kind, humble, friendly.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Formare l'architettura dei sistemi di ispezione ottica AI di Delvitech, collegando hardware, software e AI in una piattaforma affidabile. Dipartimento: R&D Location: Mendrisio, Svizzera, 100% on-site Reports to: Head of R&D The Opportunity Delvitech sviluppa sistemi avanzati AOI (Automatic Optical Inspection) per la produzione elettronica. Stiamo cercando un System Architect per rafforzare l'architettura e l'analisi della nostra piattaforma software di nuova generazione, lavorando insieme ai nostri architetti software senior. Questo è un ruolo individuale-contributor (nessuna gestione delle persone). Principali responsabilità
• Analizzare i requisiti e tradurli in una chiara architettura di sistema: moduli, limiti di servizio, interfacce e modelli di dati.
• Contribuisci alla progettazione della futura piattaforma software di Delvitech, dal concept alla produzione.
• Fare scelte tecnologiche pragmatiche e rimanere vicino all'implementazione (prototipi, prove di concetto, recensioni di codice).
• Lead design e architettura recensioni; aumentare la qualità dell'ingegneria (strategia di test, CI/CD, performance, affidabilità, sicurezza).
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team hardware, machine-vision e software sull'integrazione hardware-software.
• Decisioni di architettura dei documenti e specifiche tecniche. Requisiti (Must Have)
• Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o un campo tecnico correlato.
• 6+ anni di esperienza di ingegneria del software, con solida esperienza pratica nell'architettura del sistema e nel design.
• Competenze forti in almeno uno di: C++, Java/Spring, Python.
• Esperienza con sistemi distribuiti / microservizi, REST/OpenAPI e Linux.
• Tracciare il record di portare sistemi software complessi in produzione.
• Fluency professionale in inglese. Bello da avere
• Esperienza con sistemi industriali, incorporati o hardware-software.
• Conoscenza della visione della macchina, AOI o SMT/elettronica di produzione.
• Rust, TypeScript/React.
• Docker/Kubernetes, strumenti di osservazione (Grafana, Prometheus).
• Esperienza di integrazione dei componenti AI nel software di produzione.
• Italiano o tedesco. Soft Skills Il pensiero strutturato e analitico, il pragmatismo, la comunicazione chiara con gli stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici, l'atteggiamento di mentoring, la proprietà, gentile, umile, amichevole.

Département: R-D Lieu: Mendrisio, Suisse, 100% sur place Rapports à: Chef de la R-D The Opportunity Delvitech développe des systèmes AOI (Automatic Optical Inspection) avancés pour la fabrication électronique. jobs.title: Quality Program Manager – Cross-Functional Projects
jobs.description:
Lead cross-functional quality projects at Delvitech, aligning teams, improving processes and turning data into measurable results. Job Summary We are looking for a Quality Program Manager to lead and coordinate cross-functional improvement initiatives involving Quality, R&D, Production, Application Engineering, HPT, IT and other functions. The role turns quality and improvement objectives into structured, measurable and executable programs with clear ownership, priorities, resources, milestones and completion criteria, combining project management, process improvement and technical coordination to improve both company processes and product performance. Key Responsibilities
• Coordinate cross-functional quality improvement programs covering business processes and the technical performance of products and systems.
• Translate high-level objectives into projects, deliverables, milestones, responsibilities and measurable success criteria.
• Work with functional managers to prioritize activities and secure the necessary resources.
• Monitor dependencies, risks, delays and open decisions, escalating when required.
• Facilitate alignment and decision making between Quality, R&D, Production, Application Engineering, HPT, IT and Management.
• Analyze processes, identify inefficiencies and bottlenecks, and coordinate improvement actions.
• Define KPIs to measure the effectiveness of initiatives and ensure improvements are embedded in daily processes.
• Prepare concise management reports, risk registers and progress updates, using AI and digital tools for analysis and action tracking. Requirements
• Experience managing or coordinating technical, industrial, product or cross-functional projects.
• Strong organizational, planning and project management skills.
• Proven ability to coordinate stakeholders across functions without direct authority.
• Ability to understand technical topics and complex systems to support decision making.
• Experience in process analysis and improvement, with a structured, data-driven approach.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Familiarity with Jira, Confluence or similar tools and with AI tools.
• Professional working proficiency in English. Nice to Have
• Experience in product-based, industrial or technology companies with technically complex products.
• Experience coordinating projects involving both software and hardware.
• Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma or Agile.
• Experience with KPIs, dashboards or Business Intelligence tools. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del programma di qualità – Progetti cross-Functional

descriptionByLocale.it:
Condurre progetti di qualità interfunzionali a Delvitech, allineare i team, migliorare i processi e trasformare i dati in risultati misurabili. Sintesi del lavoro Stiamo cercando un responsabile del programma di qualità per guidare e coordinare iniziative di miglioramento interfunzionali che coinvolgono Qualità, R&D, Produzione, Ingegneria delle applicazioni, HPT, IT e altre funzioni. Il ruolo trasforma gli obiettivi di qualità e miglioramento in programmi strutturati, misurabili ed eseguibili con chiara proprietà, priorità, risorse, pietre miliari e criteri di completamento, combinando la gestione del progetto, il miglioramento del processo e il coordinamento tecnico per migliorare sia i processi aziendali che le prestazioni del prodotto. Principali responsabilità
• Coordinate i programmi di miglioramento della qualità trasversale che coprono i processi aziendali e le prestazioni tecniche dei prodotti e dei sistemi.
• Traduci obiettivi di alto livello in progetti, realizzabili, pietre miliari, responsabilità e criteri di successo misurabili.
• Lavorare con i manager funzionali per priorità attività e garantire le risorse necessarie.
• Monitorare le dipendenze, i rischi, i ritardi e le decisioni aperte, aumentando quando necessario.
• Facilita l'allineamento e il processo decisionale tra Qualità, R&D, Produzione, Ingegneria delle applicazioni, HPT, IT e Gestione.

jobs.title: Customer / Field Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Be the voice of Delvitech's customers in quality: analyse field issues, improve escalation processes and drive lasting fixes. Job Summary We are looking for a Customer / Field Quality Engineer to create a structured connection between issues observed at customer sites and the continuous improvement of our products, processes and Quality system. The role works closely with Application Engineering, HPT, R&D, Production and Quality, analyzing escalations, failures and complaints to identify trends and systemic causes. It does not replace operational support: it ensures that field information becomes evidence, corrective actions, product improvements, requirements, tests and reusable knowledge, and it develops the end-to-end customer issue and escalation process. Key Responsibilities
• Analyze customer complaints, escalations, field failures and recurring issues.
• Design and continuously improve an end-to-end ticketing and escalation system, from the customer through support levels L1, L2 and L3 to Quality and engineering.
• Define the information, evidence, ownership and traceability required at each stage, linking issues to serial number, configuration, software release and components.
• Identify trends and systemic issues and distinguish isolated events from issues requiring structural action.
• Coordinate Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), verifying their effectiveness.
• Define and monitor Field Quality KPIs and contribute to Quality reporting for management.
• Ensure significant field issues are translated into requirements, test cases or regression tests together with R&D and validation teams.
• Turn validated solutions into knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides; use AI and data tools to classify tickets and identify patterns. Requirements
• Experience in Customer Quality, Field Quality, Application Engineering, Technical Support, Field Service or equivalent roles.
• Experience with Root Cause Analysis, corrective actions and structured problem solving.
• Strong analytical skills and ability to work with data, tickets and failure histories from multiple sources.
• Ability to design and improve ticketing, escalation and issue-management processes.
• Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Familiarity with ticketing systems and traceability tools.
• Professional working proficiency in English. Nice to Have
• Experience with AOI, machine vision, inspection systems or complex industrial equipment.
• Familiarity with 8D, CAPA, FMEA or Six Sigma.
• Experience with Jira, CRM or service management platforms.
• Experience analyzing field reliability, complaints or warranty data. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Knowledge Systems & AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Build Delvitech's internal knowledge platform with LLMs, RAG and knowledge graphs, turning company know-how into reliable AI tools. Job Summary We are looking for a Knowledge Systems & AI Engineer to design and develop a company-wide knowledge infrastructure that collects, organizes and connects information from different sources, systems and people, and makes it usable by people, software and AI systems. The infrastructure must represent our product as a cyber-physical system, connecting software, electronics, mechanics, components, configurations, calibrations, requirements, tests, failures and procedures, in the correct context of each product, version and configuration. It will support requirements definition, software development, impact analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, training and decision making. Key Responsibilities
• Define the architecture and technical roadmap of the company knowledge infrastructure.
• Design a structured knowledge model of products, subsystems, components, configurations, software, requirements, tests, calibrations, failures and procedures.
• Integrate sources such as Confluence, Jira, GitHub, technical databases and documentation, including engineering data such as BOMs and hardware revisions.
• Design retrieval, semantic search and grounding systems based on verifiable company sources, evaluating RAG, knowledge graphs, vector databases and ontologies.
• Make knowledge securely accessible to AI tools, internal applications and coding assistants, with appropriate access and permission levels.
• Design AI applications for technical troubleshooting and AI workflows to capture and validate knowledge from experts.
• Implement human-in-the-loop validation, safeguards against hallucination, data leakage and prompt injection, and metrics for accuracy and usefulness.
• Collaborate with Quality, R&D, Application Engineering, Production and Technical Writing, avoiding dependency on a single AI vendor. Requirements
• Strong ability to design and develop complex software systems integrating data, AI and services.
• Practical experience with AI, Large Language Models or knowledge management solutions.
• Good knowledge of APIs, databases and system integration.
• Knowledge of RAG, semantic retrieval, grounding and knowledge graph principles.
• Ability to model complex technical domains and cyber-physical products.
• Good understanding of LLM risks and of access control and permissioning principles.
• Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills; ability to work with subject-matter experts.
• Professional working proficiency in English. Nice to Have
• Hands-on experience with RAG, knowledge graphs, vector databases, semantic search or agentic workflows.
• Familiarity with MCP or equivalent protocols.
• Experience integrating Jira, Confluence, GitHub or enterprise platforms.
• Familiarity with Systems Engineering, SysML, PLM or BOM data.
• Experience with AI evaluation, observability and monitoring. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

Costruire la piattaforma di conoscenza interna di Delvitech con LLM, RAG e grafici di conoscenza, trasformando il know-how aziendale in strumenti AI affidabili. Sintesi del lavoro Stiamo cercando un Knowledge Systems & AI Engineer per progettare e sviluppare un'infrastruttura di conoscenza a livello aziendale che raccoglie, organizza e collega le informazioni da diverse fonti, sistemi e persone, e lo rende utilizzabile da persone, software e sistemi AI. L'infrastruttura deve rappresentare il nostro prodotto come sistema cyber-fisico, collegando software, elettronica, meccanica, componenti, configurazioni, tarature, requisiti, test, guasti e procedure, nel contesto corretto di ogni prodotto, versione e configurazione. Supporterà la definizione dei requisiti, lo sviluppo del software, l'analisi degli impatti, la risoluzione dei problemi, la documentazione, la formazione e il processo decisionale. Principali responsabilità
• Definire l'architettura e la roadmap tecnica dell'infrastruttura di conoscenza aziendale.
• Progettare un modello di conoscenza strutturato di prodotti, sottosistemi, componenti, configurazioni, software, requisiti, test, calibrazioni, guasti e procedure.
• Integrare fonti come Confluence, Jira, GitHub, database tecnici e documentazione, compresi i dati di ingegneria come BOM e le revisioni hardware.
• Sistemi di recupero, ricerca semantica e messa a terra basati su fonti aziendali verificabili, valutazione RAG, grafici di conoscenza, database vettoriali e onlogie.
• Rendere la conoscenza sicura accessibile agli strumenti AI, applicazioni interne e assistenti di codifica, con adeguati livelli di accesso e autorizzazioni.
• Applicazioni di progettazione AI per la risoluzione dei problemi tecnici e flussi di lavoro AI per catturare e convalidare le conoscenze da parte di esperti.
• Implementare la validazione umana-in-loop, salvaguardare contro allucinazione, perdita di dati e iniezione rapida, e metriche per accuratezza e utilità.
• Collabora con Quality, R&D, Application Engineering, Production e Technical Writing, evitando la dipendenza da un singolo fornitore di AI. Requisiti
• Forte capacità di progettare e sviluppare sistemi software complessi che integrano dati, AI e servizi.
• Esperienza pratica con AI, Modelli di Lingua Grande o soluzioni di gestione della conoscenza.
• Buona conoscenza delle API, database e integrazione di sistema.
• Conoscenza di RAG, retrival semantico, basi e principi del grafico della conoscenza.
• Capacità di modellare domini tecnici complessi e prodotti cyber-fisici.
• Buona comprensione dei rischi LLM e dei principi di controllo dell'accesso e di autorizzazione.
• Forte capacità analitiche e sistemistiche; capacità di lavorare con esperti di materia.
• La competenza professionale in inglese. Bello da avere
• Esperienza pratica con RAG, grafici di conoscenza, database vettoriali, flussi di lavoro semantici o agentici.
• Familiarità con MCP o protocolli equivalenti.
• Esperienza di integrazione Jira, Confluence, GitHub o piattaforme aziendali.
• Familiarità con sistemi di ingegneria, dati SysML, PLM o BOM.
• Esperienza con la valutazione, l'osservanza e il monitoraggio dell'AI. Una posizione permanente in una società tecnologica in rapida crescita che sviluppa i propri sistemi di ispezione ottica basati su AI, con forti opportunità di crescita professionale man mano che l'azienda si espande.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Build Delvitech's internal knowledge platform with LLMs, RAG and knowledge graphs, turning company know-how into reliable AI tools. Job Summary We are looking for a Knowledge Systems & AI Engineer to design and develop a company-wide knowledge infrastructure that collects, organizes and connects information from different sources, systems and people, and makes it usable by people, software and AI systems. The infrastructure must represent our product as a cyber-physical system, connecting software, electronics, mechanics, components, configurations, calibrations, requirements, tests, failures and procedures, in the correct context of each product, version and configuration. It will support requirements definition, software development, impact analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, training and decision making. Key Responsibilities
• Define the architecture and technical roadmap of the company knowledge infrastructure.
• Design a structured knowledge model of products, subsystems, components, configurations, software, requirements, tests, calibrations, failures and procedures.
• Integrate sources such as Confluence, Jira, GitHub, technical databases and documentation, including engineering data such as BOMs and hardware revisions.
• Design retrieval, semantic search and grounding systems based on verifiable company sources, evaluating RAG, knowledge graphs, vector databases and ontologies.
• Make knowledge securely accessible to AI tools, internal applications and coding assistants, with appropriate access and permission levels.
• Design AI applications for technical troubleshooting and AI workflows to capture and validate knowledge from experts.
• Implement human-in-the-loop validation, safeguards against hallucination, data leakage and prompt injection, and metrics for accuracy and usefulness.
• Collaborate with Quality, R&D, Application Engineering, Production and Technical Writing, avoiding dependency on a single AI vendor. Requirements
• Strong ability to design and develop complex software systems integrating data, AI and services.
• Practical experience with AI, Large Language Models or knowledge management solutions.
• Good knowledge of APIs, databases and system integration.
• Knowledge of RAG, semantic retrieval, grounding and knowledge graph principles.
• Ability to model complex technical domains and cyber-physical products.
• Good understanding of LLM risks and of access control and permissioning principles.
• Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills; ability to work with subject-matter experts.
• Professional working proficiency in English. Nice to Have
• Hands-on experience with RAG, knowledge graphs, vector databases, semantic search or agentic workflows.
• Familiarity with MCP or equivalent protocols.
• Experience integrating Jira, Confluence, GitHub or enterprise platforms.
• Familiarity with Systems Engineering, SysML, PLM or BOM data.
• Experience with AI evaluation, observability and monitoring. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bauen Sie Delvitechs interne Wissensplattform mit LLMs, RAGs und Wissensgraphen auf und verwandeln Sie Unternehmens-Know-how in zuverlässige KI-Tools. Stellenbeschreibung Wir suchen einen Knowledge Systems & AI Engineer, um eine unternehmensweite Wissensinfrastruktur zu entwerfen und zu entwickeln, die Informationen aus verschiedenen Quellen, Systemen und Menschen sammelt, organisiert und verbindet und sie für Menschen, Software und KI-Systeme nutzbar macht. Die Infrastruktur muss unser Produkt als cyber-physisches System darstellen, das Software, Elektronik, Mechanik, Komponenten, Konfigurationen, Kalibrierungen, Anforderungen, Tests, Fehler und Verfahren im richtigen Kontext jedes Produkts, jeder Version und Konfiguration verbindet. Es wird die Anforderungsdefinition, Softwareentwicklung, Folgenanalyse, Fehlersuche, Dokumentation, Schulung und Entscheidungsfindung unterstützen. Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
• Definieren Sie die Architektur und die technische Roadmap der Wissensinfrastruktur des Unternehmens.
• Entwerfen Sie ein strukturiertes Wissensmodell von Produkten, Subsystemen, Komponenten, Konfigurationen, Software, Anforderungen, Tests, Kalibrierungen, Fehlern und Verfahren.
• Integrieren Sie Quellen wie Confluence, Jira, GitHub, technische Datenbanken und Dokumentationen, einschließlich technischer Daten wie Stücklisten und Hardwarerevisionen.
• Design Retrieval, semantische Such- und Erdungssysteme basierend auf überprüfbaren Unternehmensquellen, Auswertung von RAG, Wissensgraphen, Vektordatenbanken und Ontologien.
• Machen Sie Wissen sicher zugänglich für KI-Tools, interne Anwendungen und Codierassistenten, mit entsprechenden Zugriffs- und Berechtigungsstufen.
• Entwerfen Sie KI-Anwendungen für technische Fehlersuche und KI-Workflows, um das Wissen von Experten zu erfassen und zu validieren.
• Implementieren Sie Human-in-the-Loop-Validierung, Schutzmaßnahmen gegen Halluzinationen, Datenlecks und sofortige Injektion sowie Metriken für Genauigkeit und Nützlichkeit.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Qualität, Forschung und Entwicklung, Anwendungstechnik, Produktion und technischem Schreiben zusammen und vermeiden Sie die Abhängigkeit von einem einzigen KI-Anbieter. Anforderungen
• Starke Fähigkeit, komplexe Softwaresysteme zu entwerfen und zu entwickeln, die Daten, KI und Dienste integrieren.
• Praktische Erfahrung mit KI, großen Sprachmodellen oder Wissensmanagement-Lösungen.
• Gute Kenntnisse über APIs, Datenbanken und Systemintegration.
• Wissen über RAG, semantisches Abrufen, Erdung und Wissensgraphenprinzipien.
• Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Domänen und cyber-physische Produkte zu modellieren.
• Gutes Verständnis der LLM-Risiken und der Zugangskontrolle und Genehmigungsgrundsätze.
• Starke analytische und systemdenkende Fähigkeiten; Fähigkeit, mit Fachexperten zu arbeiten.
• Professionelle Arbeitskenntnisse in Englisch. Nizza zu haben
• Praktische Erfahrung mit RAG, Wissensgraphen, Vektordatenbanken, semantischer Suche oder agentischen Workflows.
• Vertrautheit mit MCP oder gleichwertigen Protokollen.
• Erleben Sie die Integration von Jira, Confluence, GitHub oder Unternehmensplattformen.
• Vertrautheit mit Systems Engineering, SysML, PLM oder BOM Daten.
• Erfahrung mit KI-Bewertung, Beobachtbarkeit und Überwachung. Eine feste Position in einem schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen, das seine eigenen KI-basierten optischen Inspektionssysteme entwickelt, mit starken Möglichkeiten für professionelles Wachstum, wenn das Unternehmen expandiert.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Construisez la plateforme de connaissances interne de Delvitech avec des LLM, des RAG et des graphiques de connaissances, transformant le savoir-faire de l'entreprise en outils d'IA fiables. Résumé de l'emploi Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur des systèmes et de l'intelligence artificielle pour concevoir et développer une infrastructure de connaissances à l'échelle de l'entreprise qui recueille, organise et connecte des informations provenant de différentes sources, systèmes et personnes, et qui les rend utilisables par les personnes, les logiciels et les systèmes d'intelligence artificielle. L'infrastructure doit représenter notre produit comme un système cyberphysique, logiciel de connexion, électronique, mécanique, composants, configurations, calibrations, exigences, tests, défaillances et procédures, dans le contexte correct de chaque produit, version et configuration. Il appuiera la définition des exigences, le développement de logiciels, l'analyse d'impact, le dépannage, la documentation, la formation et la prise de décisions. Principales responsabilités

• Concevoir un modèle structuré de connaissance des produits, sous-systèmes, composants, configurations, logiciels, exigences, tests, calibrations, défaillances et procédures.
• Intégrer des sources telles que Confluence, Jira, GitHub, des bases de données techniques et de la documentation, y compris des données d'ingénierie comme les BOM et les révisions matérielles.
• Recherche de conception, recherche sémantique et systèmes de base basés sur des sources d'entreprises vérifiables, évaluation RAG, graphiques de connaissances, bases de données vectorielles et ontologies.
• Rendre les connaissances accessibles en toute sécurité aux outils d'IA, aux applications internes et aux assistants de codage, avec des niveaux d'accès et de permission appropriés.
• Concevoir des applications d'IA pour le dépannage technique et les workflows d'IA pour capter et valider les connaissances des experts.

• Collaborer avec Qualité, R-D, Ingénierie d'application, Production et rédaction technique, en évitant de dépendre d'un seul fournisseur d'IA. Exigences
• Forte capacité à concevoir et développer des systèmes logiciels complexes intégrant les données, l'IA et les services.
• Expérience pratique avec l'IA, les modèles de grande langue ou les solutions de gestion des connaissances.
• Bonne connaissance des API, des bases de données et de l'intégration des systèmes.
• Connaissance des principes du RAG, de l'extraction sémantique, de la mise à la terre et du graphique des connaissances.
• Capacité de modéliser des domaines techniques complexes et des produits cyberphysiques.
• Bonne compréhension des risques liés à la LLM et des principes de contrôle d'accès et d'autorisation.
• Forte capacité d'analyse et de réflexion des systèmes; aptitude à travailler avec des experts en la matière.
• Compétence professionnelle en anglais. Sympa d'avoir
• Expérience pratique avec RAG, graphiques de connaissances, bases de données vectorielles, recherche sémantique ou workflows d'agents.
• Connaissance des protocoles MCP ou équivalents.
• Expérience intégrant Jira, Confluence, GitHub ou plateformes d'entreprise.
• Connaissance des données de l'ingénierie des systèmes, SysML, PLM ou BOM.
• Expérience de l'évaluation, de l'observation et du suivi de l'IA. Ce que nous offrons Une position permanente dans une société technologique en croissance rapide qui développe ses propres systèmes d'inspection optique basés sur l'IA, avec de fortes opportunités de croissance professionnelle à mesure que l'entreprise s'étend.

jobs.title: Technical Writer & Knowledge Content Specialist
jobs.description:
Capture expert know-how and turn it into clear, structured technical content for Delvitech's AI inspection machines and knowledge base. Job Summary We are looking for a Technical Writer & Knowledge Content Specialist to transform complex technical knowledge into clear, structured, maintainable and reusable content for customers, Application Engineering, Production, R&D and other functions. The role goes beyond writing standalone documents: it builds and maintains a structured technical content system, connected to product knowledge and designed to be used by both people and AI tools, in close collaboration with technical experts and the Knowledge Systems & AI Engineer. Key Responsibilities
• Create and improve technical manuals, installation, maintenance and troubleshooting guides, operating procedures, application notes and training materials.
• Transform information from R&D, Production, Application Engineering and other experts into clear and accurate content for each audience.
• Organize documentation into modular content, define templates, editorial standards and terminology, and link content to machine models, configurations and software releases.
• Define review, approval, versioning and publication processes, and keep documentation updated with product and process changes.
• Turn resolved field issues into reusable troubleshooting guides and knowledge articles, and support production and inspection instructions.
• Support multilingual content with consistent terminology.
• Structure documentation so it can be used effectively by search systems, knowledge bases and AI agents.
• Use AI daily for drafts, summaries, restructuring, translation and gap detection, always verifying technical accuracy. Requirements
• Excellent technical writing and synthesis skills, with the ability to simplify complex subjects.
• Experience creating and managing technical documentation, procedures, manuals or knowledge content.
• Ability to interview subject-matter experts and clarify ambiguities.
• Good understanding of structured documentation, content life cycle, versioning and governance.
• Strong familiarity with Generative AI tools and the ability to validate their output critically.
• Strong attention to accuracy and terminology consistency.
• Excellent written English. Nice to Have
• Experience with documentation for industrial machines, complex software, machine vision or integrated hardware and software systems.
• Familiarity with Confluence, Markdown, Git, documentation-as-code or knowledge management systems.
• Experience with structured authoring or single-source publishing tools.
• Experience creating videos, diagrams or interactive training content. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Acquisire know-how esperto e trasformarlo in contenuto tecnico chiaro e strutturato per le macchine di ispezione AI di Delvitech e la base di conoscenza. Sintesi del lavoro Siamo alla ricerca di uno specialista del contenuto tecnico di Writer & Knowledge per trasformare le conoscenze tecniche complesse in contenuti chiari, strutturati, manutenbili e riutilizzabili per i clienti, Application Engineering, Production, R&D e altre funzioni. Il ruolo va oltre la scrittura di documenti standalone: costruisce e mantiene un sistema di contenuti tecnici strutturato, collegato alla conoscenza del prodotto e progettato per essere utilizzato sia da persone che da strumenti AI, in stretta collaborazione con esperti tecnici e il Knowledge Systems & AI Engineer. Principali responsabilità
• Creare e migliorare manuali tecnici, installazione, manutenzione e guide di risoluzione dei problemi, procedure operative, note di applicazione e materiali di formazione.
• Trasformare le informazioni da R&D, Production, Application Engineering e altri esperti in contenuti chiari e precisi per ogni pubblico.
• Organizzare la documentazione in contenuti modulari, definire modelli, standard editoriali e terminologia, e collegare contenuti a modelli di macchine, configurazioni e release software.
• Definire la revisione, l'approvazione, la versione e i processi di pubblicazione e mantenere la documentazione aggiornata con i cambiamenti di prodotto e processo.
• Trasforma i problemi di campo risolti in guide di risoluzione dei problemi riutilizzabili e articoli di conoscenza, e supporta le istruzioni di produzione e di ispezione.
• Supporta contenuti multilingue con terminologia coerente.
• Documentazione struttura in modo che possa essere utilizzato efficacemente da sistemi di ricerca, basi di conoscenza e agenti AI.
• Utilizzare AI ogni giorno per bozze, sintesi, ristrutturazione, traduzione e rilevamento gap, verificando sempre precisione tecnica. Requisiti
• Eccellente capacità di scrittura e sintesi tecnica, con la capacità di semplificare i soggetti complessi.
• Scopri la creazione e la gestione di documentazione tecnica, procedure, manuali o contenuti di conoscenza.
• Capacità di intervistare esperti soggetti-materia e chiarire ambiguità.
• Buona comprensione della documentazione strutturata, ciclo di vita dei contenuti, versione e governance.
• Forte familiarità con gli strumenti Generative AI e la capacità di convalidare il loro output in modo critico.
• Forte attenzione alla precisione e alla consistenza terminologica.
• Eccellente inglese scritto. Bello da avere
• Esperienza con documentazione per macchine industriali, software complesso, visione della macchina o sistemi hardware e software integrati.
• Familiarità con Confluence, Markdown, Git, documentazione-as-code o sistemi di gestione della conoscenza.
• Esperienza con strumenti di autore strutturato o di pubblicazione di singole risorse.
• Prova a creare video, diagrammi o contenuti interattivi di formazione. Una posizione permanente in una società tecnologica in rapida crescita che sviluppa i propri sistemi di ispezione ottica basati su AI, con forti opportunità di crescita professionale man mano che l'azienda si espande.

Erfassen Sie Expertenwissen und verwandeln Sie es in klare, strukturierte technische Inhalte für die KI-Inspektionsmaschinen und die Wissensdatenbank von Delvitech. Stellenbeschreibung Wir suchen einen Technical Writer & Knowledge Content Specialist, um komplexes technisches Wissen in klare, strukturierte, wartbare und wiederverwendbare Inhalte für Kunden, Application Engineering, Produktion, Forschung und Entwicklung und andere Funktionen umzuwandeln. Die Rolle geht über das Schreiben von eigenständigen Dokumenten hinaus: Es baut und pflegt ein strukturiertes technisches Inhaltssystem, das mit Produktwissen verbunden ist und sowohl von Menschen als auch von KI-Tools in enger Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Experten und dem Knowledge Systems & AI Engineer verwendet werden kann. • Organisieren Sie die Dokumentation in modularen Inhalten, definieren Sie Vorlagen, redaktionelle Standards und Terminologie und verknüpfen Sie Inhalte mit Maschinenmodellen, Konfigurationen und Software-Releases.
• Definieren Sie Überprüfungs-, Genehmigungs-, Versionierungs- und Publikationsprozesse und halten Sie die Dokumentation mit Produkt- und Prozessänderungen auf dem neuesten Stand.
• Verwandeln Sie gelöste Feldprobleme in wiederverwendbare Fehlerbehebungsleitfäden und Wissensartikel und unterstützen Sie Produktions- und Inspektionsanweisungen.
• Unterstützen Sie mehrsprachige Inhalte mit konsistenter Terminologie.
• Strukturieren Sie die Dokumentation so, dass sie von Suchsystemen, Wissensdatenbanken und KI-Agenten effektiv genutzt werden kann.
• Verwenden Sie KI täglich für Entwürfe, Zusammenfassungen, Restrukturierung, Übersetzung und Lückenerkennung, wobei immer die technische Genauigkeit überprüft wird. Anforderungen
• Hervorragende technische Schreib- und Synthesefähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen zu vereinfachen.
• Erfahrung beim Erstellen und Verwalten von technischer Dokumentation, Verfahren, Handbüchern oder Wissensinhalten.
• Möglichkeit, Experten zu befragen und Unklarheiten zu klären.
• Gutes Verständnis von strukturierter Dokumentation, Content Lifecycle, Versionierung und Governance.
• Starke Vertrautheit mit Generative AI-Tools und die Fähigkeit, ihre Ergebnisse kritisch zu validieren.
• Starke Aufmerksamkeit auf Genauigkeit und Terminologiekonsistenz.

• Erfahrung mit Dokumentation für Industriemaschinen, komplexe Software, Machine Vision oder integrierte Hard- und Softwaresysteme.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Capturez le savoir-faire expert et transformez-le en contenu technique clair et structuré pour les machines d'inspection et la base de connaissances de Delvitech. Résumé de l'emploi Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Technical Writer & Knowledge Content Specialist pour transformer des connaissances techniques complexes en contenu clair, structuré, durable et réutilisable pour les clients, Ingénierie d'application, Production, R & D et autres fonctions. Le rôle va au-delà de l'écriture de documents autonomes : il construit et maintient un système de contenu technique structuré, connecté aux connaissances des produits et conçu pour être utilisé à la fois par les personnes et les outils d'IA, en étroite collaboration avec les experts techniques et l'ingénieur des systèmes de connaissances et de l'IA. • Créer et améliorer des manuels techniques, des guides d'installation, de maintenance et de dépannage, des procédures d'exploitation, des notes d'application et du matériel de formation.
• Transformer l'information provenant de la R-D, de la production, du génie d'application et d'autres experts en contenu clair et précis pour chaque auditoire.
• Organisez la documentation en contenu modulaire, définissez des modèles, des normes rédactionnelles et une terminologie, et liez le contenu aux modèles de machine, aux configurations et aux versions logicielles.
• Définir les processus d'examen, d'approbation, de mise en forme et de publication et tenir la documentation à jour en fonction des changements apportés aux produits et aux procédés.
• Transformer les problèmes résolus sur le terrain en guides de dépannage réutilisables et en articles de connaissances, et appuyer les instructions de production et d'inspection.
• Soutenir le contenu multilingue avec une terminologie cohérente.
• La documentation de structure afin qu'elle puisse être utilisée efficacement par les systèmes de recherche, les bases de connaissances et les agents d'IA.
• Utiliser l'IA quotidiennement pour les ébauches, les résumés, la restructuration, la traduction et la détection des lacunes, en vérifiant toujours la précision technique. Exigences
• Excellentes compétences techniques d'écriture et de synthèse, avec la capacité de simplifier des sujets complexes.
• Expérience dans la création et la gestion de documents techniques, de procédures, de manuels ou de contenus de connaissances.
• Capacité d'interviewer des experts et de clarifier les ambiguïtés.
• Bonne compréhension de la documentation structurée, du cycle de vie du contenu, de la version et de la gouvernance.
• Bonne connaissance des outils d'IA Generative et de la capacité de valider leur sortie de manière critique.
• Une grande attention à l'exactitude et à la cohérence terminologique.
• Excellent anglais écrit. Sympa d'avoir

jobs.title: QMS & Compliance Specialist (part-time / external)
jobs.description:
Part-time or external role: maintain Delvitech's ISO 9001, 14001 and 27001 management systems, lead audits and drive continuous improvement. Job Summary We are looking for a QMS & Compliance Specialist (part-time or external) to develop, maintain and continuously improve the company's management systems, keeping processes, procedures, responsibilities and evidence aligned with the applicable ISO and IEC standards and with the way the organization actually works. The role maintains the existing ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 systems and plays a key role in the design, implementation and certification path of an ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management System, translating requirements into practical, auditable and sustainable processes without unnecessary bureaucracy. Key Responsibilities
• Maintain and continuously improve the ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certified management systems.
• Support the design, implementation and certification preparation of the ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS, including risk assessments, policies, procedures and evidence.
• Translate ISO/IEC requirements into practical processes, responsibilities, controls and objective evidence.
• Perform gap analyses, map company processes and define improvement actions with clear owners.
• Plan and coordinate internal and certification audits and manage findings, non-conformities and corrective actions.
• Verify that documented processes are effectively implemented and supported by up-to-date evidence.
• Collaborate with IT, R&D and technical functions, while technical implementation of security controls stays with the technical owners.
• Define compliance KPIs, support training and awareness, and coordinate external specialists when needed.
• Use AI and digital tools to support gap analyses, audit preparation and document review, with human validation of conclusions. Requirements
• Practical experience in managing ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 management systems.
• Good practical knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001 and Information Security Management Systems.
• Experience with audits, process governance and management-system compliance.
• Ability to translate ISO/IEC requirements into clear, practical and auditable processes.
• Strong process analysis and mapping skills.
• Structured, precise and evidence-driven approach; ability to work with technical, operational and management stakeholders.
• Comfortable with digital and AI tools.
• Professional working proficiency in English. Nice to Have
• Direct experience in an ISO/IEC 27001 implementation or certification project.
• Knowledge of IEC 62443 or other industrial cybersecurity standards.
• Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor training or experience.
• Experience with management systems across multiple sites or international production locations. What We Offer A part-time or external collaboration with a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Production & Supplier Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Drive quality across Delvitech's production and suppliers: map processes, solve root causes and raise the standard of every machine we build. Job Summary We are looking for a Production & Supplier Quality Engineer to ensure the quality, stability and reproducibility of the production processes, components and assemblies used in our machines. The role works closely with Production, R&D, Supply Chain and suppliers to prevent and reduce sources of variability, developing control processes, acceptance criteria, measurement methods and common production standards that are objective, repeatable and consistent across suppliers and production sites. Key Responsibilities
• Analyze production and assembly processes, identifying variability, critical points and improvement opportunities.
• Define and improve process controls, acceptance criteria and verification methods, including clear and measurable machine acceptance criteria.
• Identify, with Engineering and R&D, the critical characteristics and parameters that affect final machine performance.
• Define and maintain Incoming Quality controls for critical components and assemblies.
• Develop Supplier Quality activities, monitor supplier performance and support the qualification of new suppliers, components and processes.
• Manage internal and supplier non-conformities, coordinating Root Cause Analysis and corrective actions and verifying their effectiveness.
• Analyze defects, rework, scrap and production data, using statistical methods to assess process stability and capability.
• Maintain Control Plans, checklists, inspection instructions and production records, and define Production and Supplier Quality KPIs.
• Align Quality processes across production sites, including production in India, together with the local Quality team.
• Use AI and data analysis tools to support non-conformity analysis, trend detection and reporting. Requirements
• Experience in Production Quality, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrialization or equivalent technical roles.
• Strong ability to analyze, map and optimize production processes.
• Experience with non-conformities, Root Cause Analysis and corrective actions.
• Ability to define acceptance criteria and control methods based on objective measurements.
• Ability to read technical drawings, specifications and tolerances.
• Good understanding of statistical process analysis and production variability.
• Practical, structured and data-driven approach; ability to work with operators, engineers, Supply Chain and suppliers.
• Professional working proficiency in English. Nice to Have
• Experience with products integrating mechanics, electronics, optics, motion control and software.
• Familiarity with FMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, Lean or Six Sigma.
• Experience with supplier audits, qualification or development, including international suppliers.
• Experience with ERP, MES, traceability systems or Business Intelligence tools. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Qualità dell'azionamento attraverso la produzione e i fornitori di Delvitech: processi di mappa, risolvere cause root e aumentare lo standard di ogni macchina che costruiamo. Sintesi del lavoro Stiamo cercando un ingegnere di qualità di produzione e fornitore per garantire la qualità, la stabilità e la riproducibilità dei processi di produzione, componenti e assemblaggi utilizzati nelle nostre macchine. Il ruolo lavora a stretto contatto con la Produzione, R&D, Supply Chain e i fornitori per prevenire e ridurre le fonti di variabilità, sviluppare processi di controllo, criteri di accettazione, metodi di misura e standard di produzione comuni che sono oggettivi, ripetibili e coerenti tra fornitori e siti di produzione. Principali responsabilità
• Analizzare i processi di produzione e assemblaggio, identificare variabilità, punti critici e opportunità di miglioramento.
• Definire e migliorare i controlli di processo, i criteri di accettazione e i metodi di verifica, compresi i criteri di accettazione delle macchine chiare e misurabili.
• Identificare, con Engineering e R&D, le caratteristiche critiche e i parametri che influiscono sulle prestazioni della macchina finale.
• Definire e mantenere i controlli Incoming Quality per componenti e assemblaggi critici.
• Sviluppare attività di qualità del fornitore, monitorare le prestazioni del fornitore e supportare la qualificazione di nuovi fornitori, componenti e processi.
• Gestisci le non conformità interne e dei fornitori, coordinando l'analisi delle cause della radice e le azioni correttive e verificandone l'efficacia.
• Analizzare difetti, rielaborazione, scarti e dati di produzione, utilizzando metodi statistici per valutare la stabilità e la capacità del processo.
• Mantenere piani di controllo, liste di controllo, istruzioni di ispezione e record di produzione, e definire i KPI di qualità di produzione e fornitore.
• Allineare i processi di qualità nei siti di produzione, inclusa la produzione in India, insieme al team di qualità locale.
• Utilizzare strumenti di analisi dei dati e dell'intelligenza artificiale per supportare analisi, rilevamento e reporting non conformi. Requisiti
• Esperienza in qualità di produzione, qualità del fornitore, ingegneria manifatturiera, industrializzazione o ruoli tecnici equivalenti.
• Forte capacità di analizzare, mappare e ottimizzare i processi produttivi.
• Esperienza con non conformità, Analisi delle cause della radice e azioni correttive.
• Capacità di definire criteri di accettazione e metodi di controllo basati su misurazioni oggettive.
• Capacità di leggere disegni tecnici, specifiche e tolleranze.
• Buona comprensione dell'analisi statistica del processo e della variabilità di produzione.
• Approccio pratico, strutturato e orientato ai dati; capacità di lavorare con operatori, ingegneri, Supply Chain e fornitori.
• La competenza professionale in inglese. Bello da avere
• Esperienza con prodotti che integrano meccanica, elettronica, ottica, motion control e software.
• Familiarità con FMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, Lean o Six Sigma.
• Esperienza con audit dei fornitori, qualificazione o sviluppo, compresi i fornitori internazionali.
• Esperienza con ERP, MES, sistemi di tracciabilità o strumenti di Business Intelligence. Una posizione permanente in una società tecnologica in rapida crescita che sviluppa i propri sistemi di ispezione ottica basati su AI, con forti opportunità di crescita professionale man mano che l'azienda si espande.

• Erfahrung mit Nichtkonformitäten, Ursachenanalyse und Korrekturmaßnahmen.
• Fähigkeit, Akzeptanzkriterien und Kontrollmethoden auf der Grundlage objektiver Messungen zu definieren.
• Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen, Spezifikationen und Toleranzen zu lesen.
• Gutes Verständnis der statistischen Prozessanalyse und der Produktionsvariabilität.
• Praktischer, strukturierter und datengesteuerter Ansatz; Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit mit Betreibern, Ingenieuren, Supply Chain und Lieferanten.
• Professionelle Arbeitskenntnisse in Englisch. Nizza zu haben
• Erfahrung mit Produkten, die Mechanik, Elektronik, Optik, Motion Control und Software integrieren.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Conduisez la qualité dans la production et les fournisseurs de Delvitech : cartographier les processus, résoudre les causes profondes et élever le niveau de chaque machine que nous construisons. Résumé de l'emploi Nous recherchons un ingénieur de production et de qualité fournisseur pour assurer la qualité, la stabilité et la reproductibilité des processus de production, des composants et des assemblages utilisés dans nos machines. Ce rôle travaille en étroite collaboration avec la production, la R-D, la chaîne d'approvisionnement et les fournisseurs pour prévenir et réduire les sources de variabilité, élaborer des processus de contrôle, des critères d'acceptation, des méthodes de mesure et des normes communes de production objectives, répétables et cohérentes entre les fournisseurs et les sites de production. Principales responsabilités
• Analyser les processus de production et de montage, identifier la variabilité, les points critiques et les possibilités d'amélioration.
• Définir et améliorer les contrôles des processus, les critères d'acceptation et les méthodes de vérification, y compris des critères d'acceptation des machines clairs et mesurables.
• Déterminer, avec le génie et la R-D, les caractéristiques et les paramètres critiques qui influent sur la performance finale de la machine.
• Définir et maintenir les contrôles de qualité entrants pour les composants et assemblages critiques.
• Élaborer des activités de qualité des fournisseurs, surveiller le rendement des fournisseurs et appuyer la qualification des nouveaux fournisseurs, des nouveaux composants et des nouveaux processus.
• Gérer les non-conformités internes et des fournisseurs, coordonner l'analyse des causes profondes et les mesures correctives et vérifier leur efficacité.
• Analyser les défauts, le retravail, la ferraille et les données de production en utilisant des méthodes statistiques pour évaluer la stabilité et la capacité des procédés.
• Maintenir les plans de contrôle, les listes de contrôle, les instructions d'inspection et les registres de production, et définir les ICR de la production et de la qualité des fournisseurs.
• Aligner les processus de qualité sur tous les sites de production, y compris la production en Inde, avec l'équipe locale de Qualité.
• Utiliser l'IA et les outils d'analyse de données pour appuyer l'analyse de non-conformité, la détection des tendances et les rapports. Exigences
• Expérience en qualité de production, qualité des fournisseurs, génie manufacturier, industrialisation ou rôles techniques équivalents.
• Forte capacité à analyser, cartographier et optimiser les processus de production.
• Expérience des non-conformités, de l'analyse des causes profondes et des mesures correctives.
• Capacité de définir des critères d'acceptation et des méthodes de contrôle basées sur des mesures objectives.
• Capacité de lire des dessins techniques, des spécifications et des tolérances.
• Bonne compréhension de l'analyse statistique des processus et de la variabilité de la production.
• Approche pratique, structurée et axée sur les données; capacité de travailler avec les opérateurs, les ingénieurs, la chaîne d'approvisionnement et les fournisseurs.
• Compétence professionnelle en anglais. Sympa d'avoir
• Expérience des produits intégrant la mécanique, l'électronique, l'optique, le contrôle des mouvements et les logiciels.
• Familiarité avec FMEA, Plan de contrôle, SPC, MSA, Lean ou Six Sigma.
• Expérience des audits, des qualifications ou du développement des fournisseurs, y compris des fournisseurs internationaux.
• Expérience avec les outils ERP, MES, systèmes de traçabilité ou Business Intelligence. Ce que nous offrons Une position permanente dans une société technologique en croissance rapide qui développe ses propres systèmes d'inspection optique basés sur l'IA, avec de fortes opportunités de croissance professionnelle à mesure que l'entreprise s'étend.

jobs.title: Product Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Safeguard the quality of Delvitech's AI inspection products from requirements to release, through validation, traceability and change control. Job Summary We are looking for a Product Quality Engineer to ensure that requirements, validation activities and product changes are managed through structured, traceable and evidence-based processes. The role works closely with R&D, Testing, DevOps, Production, Application Engineering and Quality across software, embedded software and firmware, electronics, hardware, mechanics and system-level changes. It does not replace R&D ownership of technical design and validation: its objective is to ensure clear Quality criteria, traceability, verifiable evidence, complete documentation and adequate readiness before a change is introduced into the product. Key Responsibilities
• Define and maintain, together with R&D, the Quality framework for requirements, validation, product changes and releases.
• Define minimum criteria for requirement quality, so that requirements are clear, verifiable, traceable and consistent.
• Verify traceability between requirements, design, implementation, testing, validation evidence and releases, and identify gaps.
• Define release and change readiness criteria and Quality gates across product development.
• Verify that, before a release or change, the required evidence and documentation are complete and that Production, Application Engineering and customer-facing functions are informed and prepared.
• Participate in design, release and change reviews, providing an independent assessment of the available evidence.
• Ensure that hardware, mechanical, electronic and embedded changes are correctly managed in terms of revisions, configurations and compatibility.
• Monitor quality trends such as escaped defects, regressions, requirement and validation gaps and field feedback, and define related KPIs.
• Collaborate with Field Quality, Testing, Production & Supplier Quality, the Technical Writer and the Knowledge Systems & AI Engineer.
• Use AI and digital tools to support requirement reviews, traceability analysis and evidence consolidation, keeping human validation of critical decisions. Requirements
• Experience in Product Quality, Software Quality, Validation, Requirements Engineering, System Engineering, Testing or equivalent roles.
• Good understanding of the development life cycle of a technical product, from requirements to validation and release.
• Ability to work across software, embedded, electronics, hardware and mechanics projects without necessarily being a specialist in each discipline.
• Good understanding of traceability, verification and validation principles.
• Ability to assess the readiness of a release or product change, including documentation, communication and impact on other functions.
• Structured, evidence-based approach and strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Familiarity with requirements, issue, test, change or documentation management tools and with AI tools.
• Professional working proficiency in English. Nice to Have
• Experience in product-based, industrial, automation or machine-building companies.
• Experience with release governance, engineering change management or product quality assurance.
• Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, GitHub, CI/CD, PLM or test management systems.
• Familiarity with risk-based testing, regression testing or readiness assessment. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Salvaguardare la qualità dei prodotti di ispezione AI di Delvitech dai requisiti per rilasciare, tramite validazione, tracciabilità e controllo dei cambiamenti. Sintesi del lavoro Cerchiamo un Product Quality Engineer per garantire che i requisiti, le attività di validazione e i cambiamenti dei prodotti siano gestiti attraverso processi strutturati, tracciabili e basati su prove. Il ruolo funziona a stretto contatto con R&D, Testing, DevOps, Production, Application Engineering e Quality attraverso software, software embedded e firmware, elettronica, hardware, meccanica e modifiche a livello di sistema. Non sostituisce la proprietà R&D della progettazione tecnica e della validazione: il suo obiettivo è quello di garantire chiari criteri di qualità, tracciabilità, prove verificabili, documentazione completa e disponibilità adeguata prima che un cambiamento venga introdotto nel prodotto. Principali responsabilità
• Definire e mantenere, insieme a R&D, il framework di qualità per i requisiti, la validazione, i cambiamenti di prodotto e le versioni.
• Definire criteri minimi per la qualità dei requisiti, in modo che i requisiti siano chiari, verificabili, tracciabili e coerenti.
• Verificare la tracciabilità tra requisiti, progettazione, implementazione, test, prove di validazione e release, e identificare lacune.
• Definire il rilascio e cambiare i criteri di disponibilità e le porte di qualità attraverso lo sviluppo del prodotto.
• Verificare che, prima di un rilascio o di una modifica, le prove e la documentazione necessarie siano complete e che le funzioni di produzione, di ingegneria delle applicazioni e di customer-facing siano informate e preparate.
• Partecipa a recensioni di progettazione, rilascio e cambiamento, fornendo una valutazione indipendente delle prove disponibili.
• Assicurarsi che le modifiche hardware, meccanico, elettronico e incorporato siano gestite correttamente in termini di revisioni, configurazioni e compatibilità.
• Monitorare le tendenze di qualità come difetti sfuggiti, regressioni, lacune di richiesta e validazione e feedback sul campo, e definire i KPI correlati.
• Collabora con qualità del campo, test, produzione e qualità del fornitore, lo scrittore tecnico e i sistemi di conoscenza & AI Engineer.
• Utilizzare l'intelligenza artificiale e strumenti digitali per supportare le recensioni dei requisiti, l'analisi della tracciabilità e il consolidamento delle prove, mantenendo la validazione umana delle decisioni critiche. Requisiti
• Esperienza nella qualità del prodotto, qualità del software, convalida, requisiti di ingegneria, ingegneria del sistema, test o ruoli equivalenti.
• Buona comprensione del ciclo di vita di sviluppo di un prodotto tecnico, dai requisiti alla convalida e al rilascio.
• Capacità di lavorare attraverso progetti software, embedded, elettronica, hardware e meccanica senza necessariamente essere uno specialista in ogni disciplina.
• Buona comprensione dei principi di tracciabilità, verifica e convalida.
• Capacità di valutare la disponibilità di un rilascio o di un cambiamento di prodotto, tra cui documentazione, comunicazione e impatto su altre funzioni.
• Approccio strutturato, basato su prove e forti capacità analitiche e di problem solving.
• Familiarità con requisiti, emissione, test, modifiche o strumenti di gestione della documentazione e con strumenti AI.
• La competenza professionale in inglese. Bello da avere
• Esperienza nelle aziende produttrici, industriali, di automazione o di costruzione di macchine.
• Esperienza con la governance del rilascio, gestione del cambiamento di ingegneria o garanzia della qualità del prodotto.
• Familiarità con Jira, Confluence, GitHub, CI/CD, PLM o sistemi di gestione dei test.
• Familiarità con test basati sul rischio, test di regressione o valutazione della disponibilità. Una posizione permanente in una società tecnologica in rapida crescita che sviluppa i propri sistemi di ispezione ottica basati su AI, con forti opportunità di crescita professionale man mano che l'azienda si espande.
